name: Dr Emily Molyneux
title: Psychologist
description: I am a Clinical Psychologist in Heathmont, Victoria. I enjoy working with you to discover what you need, and how to get those needs met. These include Dialectical Behaviour Therapy (DBT), Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), Schema Therapy, Eye Movement Desensitisation Reprocessing (EMDR), and Mindful Self-Compassion. This can involve using your faith as a resource in therapy, and/or working through religious trauma.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Dissociative Identity Disorder, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Schema Therapy, EMDR

name: Blake Blain
title: Psychologist
description: Blake Blain is a registered Clinical Psychologist, Director of b.psychology in Ringwood East. Over several years he has worked with adults and older adults across public mental health settings and private practice. Blake is motivated to help individuals improve mental health conditions such as: anxiety depression obsessive-compulsive difficulties trauma-related and dissociative experiences psychotic symptoms impulse-control concerns personality-related difficulties He also supports people experiencing: stress and burnout low self-esteem and confidence grief and loss life transitions relationship and social difficulties loneliness conflict suicidality and self-harm Blake draws on several evidence-based approaches, including Cognitive Analytic Therapy (CAT), Cognitive Behaviour Therapy (CBT), and mindfulness-based therapies.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Dissociative Identity Disorder, Sexual abuse, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD)

name: Louise Sellenger
title: Psychologist
description: As a Clinical Psychologist I provide psychological assessment and counselling services, and have a broad range of experience in practicing across both community health and community mental health settings over the past 30 years. Areas of focus include anxiety, depression, complex trauma, stress management, chronic illness and pain management, eating disorders, relationship issues and personal development.
specialties: Sexual abuse, Dissociative Identity Disorder, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), EMDR, Schema Therapy

name: Jaclyn Lee
title: Psychologist
description: I am a Clinical Psychologist and Board-Approved Supervisor and have work across private practise clinics and hospitals settings. My work has focussed on clients; adults and young persons 16+ who are experiencing, or have experienced significant emotional distress that has not been easily treated.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Dissociative Identity Disorder, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual abuse

name: Alison Murnane
title: Psychologist
description: With over 20 years of experience as a psychologist, I offer a warm, compassionate, and collaborative approach to therapy. I have worked with people at every stage of life and support clients experiencing a range of concerns, including stress, anxiety, depression, and PTSD. These difficulties often have their roots in attachment experiences, trauma, significant life events, or health challenges. I use a range of evidence-based approaches, including EMDR (Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing Therapy), IFS (Internal Family Systems) and mindfulness techniques to tailor therapy to meet each client's individual needs and circumstance.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Dissociative Identity Disorder, Sexual abuse, EMDR

name: Dr Delene Brookstein
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: I create therapeutic spaces for people who feel stuck and are tired of repeating old patterns or carrying past memories. I help clients to explore their life experiences and understand the deeper patterns shaping their thoughts, emotional reactions and relationships, while also providing practical tools for change.
specialties: Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Dissociative Identity Disorder, Schema Therapy, EMDR

name: Jocelyn Andrew
title: Psychologist
description: I have 30 years experience as a psychologist with adults, adolescents, couples & families. My style is warm & interactive. This offers you highly developed clinical skills in assessment & treatment planning & highly developed counselling skills for individualising the most effective therapy for you including CBT, DBT, ACT, IPT, IFS & Schema Therapy. I can also deepen & expand these therapies through hypnosis, power therapies & EMDR (Advanced).
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual abuse, Dissociative Identity Disorder, Sexual difficulties, Schema Therapy, EMDR

name: Sarah Wallace
title: Psychologist
description: Experienced Clinical Psychologist with a special interest in areas of attachment, trauma and neurodivergence. Utilising neuro-affirming and trauma-informed therapeutic strategies from DBT, ACT and EMDR.
specialties: Dissociative Identity Disorder, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual abuse, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, EMDR
